title: Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: A classic Uruguayan dish featuring marinated beef on skewers, perfect for grilling. This recipe yields tender and flavorful beef, ideal for a summer barbecue.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and oregano.
Add the beef cubes to the marinade and mix to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread 2-3 beef cubes onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each piece.
Season the skewers with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in foil and heating them on the grill for a few minutes.
Serve the skewers with warm tortillas, your favorite sides, and a squeeze of lime juice.
